purpose: Validate the lean V1 founder/external boundary and preserve every historical obligation; this is not external approval or release evidence.

legacyObligations.action: Create/control the Apple Account, complete identity verification and MFA, enroll, and pay Apple membership
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Prepare exact enrollment choices, guide the session, verify the resulting team/account, and configure everything afterward
legacyObligations.preservation: Apple membership, Team ID, role and redacted receipt remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Choose individual versus organization seller and provide truthful legal-entity information
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Research and recommend the best structure, prepare the information checklist, and validate consistency
legacyObligations.preservation: Truthful individual/organization seller decision and consistent legal details remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Provide banking/tax information and accept Apple or vendor legal agreements
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Prepare field-by-field guidance, check for inconsistencies, and complete all non-attestation fields
legacyObligations.preservation: Accepted Apple/minimum-vendor agreements and banking/tax status remain outstanding; private values are never retained.

legacyObligations.action: Pay for domains, memberships, professionals, vendors, moderation, or approved usage budgets
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Research vendors and prices, recommend selections, prepare purchases, and track renewals
legacyObligations.preservation: Minimum domain/membership/reviewer/vendor budgets, redacted purchases and renewal owners remain outstanding. Optional AI/catalog/commerce/community spend is deferred.

legacyObligations.action: Complete MFA, CAPTCHA, identity, phone, email, or payment challenges in external consoles
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Operate the authorized session before and after the challenge and complete configuration
legacyObligations.preservation: Private MFA/CAPTCHA/identity/phone/email/payment challenges remain external as encountered; only redacted provider status is retained.

legacyObligations.action: Approve the final recommended name after formal clearance and authorize paid reservation/filing
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Perform naming research, select the recommended winner, prepare clearance material, and execute the entire migration
legacyObligations.preservation: Written name selection, counsel conditions and authenticated reservation/filing records remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Provide genuine trademark/IP, privacy/legal, clinical, cosmetic-chemistry, and security decisions with real identity/authority
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Identify candidates, prepare packets, draft copy, organize questions, incorporate changes, generate signoff records, and verify hashes
legacyObligations.preservation: Trademark clearance and applicable V1 legal/privacy/clinical/chemistry/IP/export decisions require verified reviewer authority, exact hashes and retained signed references. Independent Security review remains OPEN. Deferred-feature reviews cannot admit those features.

legacyObligations.action: Provide or connect supported physical iPhones and perform actions that cannot be simulated, including Face ID, real-world camera conditions, and sandbox purchase confirmation when required
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Build binaries, write scripts, direct the session, collect logs/screenshots, diagnose defects, fix them, and rerun the matrix
legacyObligations.preservation: Real device/model/iOS/build/scenario evidence and named testers remain outstanding, including Face ID and purchase confirmations where used.

legacyObligations.action: Supply genuine beta users and any legally required tester consent
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Prepare recruiting materials, forms, invitations, feedback flows, dashboards, triage, fixes, and reports
legacyObligations.preservation: Genuine users and any required tester consent remain outstanding. Historical all-features cohort/retention evidence, including D1/D7/D14/D30 and sampling limits, is preserved as history; the 50–100-user mandatory beta and D14/D30 launch delay are deferred. Lean cohort guidance does not invent user feedback.

legacyObligations.action: Staff real community moderation and customer-support escalation
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Build the moderation/support tooling, rules, queues, macros, SLAs, training, monitoring, and audits
legacyObligations.preservation: Minimum support owner, privacy response, incident escalation and applicable launch on-call coverage remain independent OPEN obligations, with named coverage, acknowledgements and test incidents. Community moderation and AI-safety staffing are deferred with their closed features; Codex prepares tools, SLAs, training and escalation evidence.

legacyObligations.action: Approve pricing, launch countries, budget ceilings, binding contracts, and material business risk
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Research, model, recommend, document, and implement the approved decision
legacyObligations.preservation: Dated owner/scope/conditions for prices, launch countries, ceilings, contracts and material business risks remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Give explicit authorization to submit to App Review and to make the approved app public
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Prepare and validate the complete submission, submit when authorized, handle review, and operate launch
legacyObligations.preservation: Separate App Review submission and later public-availability authorizations remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Approve membership, app, subscriptions, TestFlight external beta, and App Store release
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Prepare compliant artifacts, submit, monitor, respond, fix, and resubmit
legacyObligations.preservation: Apple-issued membership/TestFlight/subscription/App Review/release state and exact approved build/product IDs remain outstanding.

legacyObligations.action: Approve affiliate, AI, domain, email, or other provider applications
legacyObligations.codexOwnedPreparation: Select the provider, prepare applications, configure approved accounts, and implement fallbacks
legacyObligations.preservation: Minimum production account/contract/limit approvals, applicable DPA/licence references and privacy/security/deletion configuration remain outstanding. Optional AI/catalog/affiliate/analytics/community/moderation providers are deferred.
